ideas.title: Following the Money in Medicaid Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the financial trails of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota, including the Feeding Our Future scandal
questions: How much money was lost to Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
What are the most common schemes used by fraudsters?
ideas.insight: By following the money, we can gain a better understanding of the scope and complexity of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota, and identify potential areas for improvement in the program.
